name: Control field on the ecliptic (RA 180, Dec 0)
corr_colormap: blue #56B4E9 (negative) - black - orange #E69F00 (positive), clipped at +-8 sigma
confidence_rule: unexplained: clip(0.5 + (|peak| - 5)/20, 0, 1); known asteroid: 1 (catalogued orbit; SkyBoT position error in pos_err_arcsec)
asteroid_labels: IMCCE SkyBoT cone search (geocentric, LOC=500), V < 21, 39 queries; positions moved to each frame time with SkyBoT rates. Approximation: geocentric positions; SPHEREx's low-Earth-orbit view differs by <~1 arcsec for main-belt asteroids (more for near-Earth objects)
rerun_command: scripts/build_field.py --size 48 --name ecliptic_control --ra 180.0 --dec 0.0 --title Control field on the ecliptic (RA 180, Dec 0)
name_es: Campo de control en la eclíptica (AR 180, Dec 0)
